id.description: the section id of this workflow, as the task gives it (for Thread, a boutique)

anchor.description: the id attribute of the section element, with the #; "" when this workflow writes page-head tags only (for Thread, a boutique)

implements.description: the LLD section ids this builds; empty when the run has no LLD (for Thread, a boutique)

html.description: the section's HTML only: no <html>, <head> or <body> tags; "" when this workflow writes page-head tags only (for Thread, a boutique)

head.description: page-head tags this section needs (meta, link, style or script only); "" when it needs none (for Thread, a boutique)

selectors_used.description: the ids and classes you used (for Thread, a boutique)

facts_used.description: the charter facts this section uses, copied exactly from Thread's charter
